decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several promising options, including the JBL Go 3 and the high-performance INSMY and Raymate speakers. However, the product feed is significantly cluttered with non-speaker items like travel cases and charging cables, which detracts from the shopping experience. Furthermore, looking into the reviews of the top-tier models, I found concerning reports regarding battery longevity and software loops in the UE Megablast and the renewed JBL Flip 5. Even the JBL Go 3 has a recent review claiming only an hour of battery life. Given the prevalence of accessories in the search results and the reliability concerns of the brand-name speakers available, I have decided not to make a purchase at this time.
